errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the key distinction between the two charts: the left chart shows gross fixed investments ('Bruttoanlageinvestitionen') and the right chart shows net fixed investments ('Nettoanlageinvestitionen'). This information is crucial for understanding the figure.

errors.text_span: Die grünen Balken (Gemeinden) bilden den größten Anteil in jedem Jahr
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. While the green bars (municipalities) have a large share in the early years, the blue bars (federal government) become the largest component in the later years of the observation period (e.g., from around 2018 onwards).

errors.evidence: The total investment line (black) in the right chart is predominantly positive after 2005, only becoming slightly negative at the very end of the time series. The few negative values for the total investment occur mostly before or around 2005 (e.g., 1998, 2003-2005).
